messages:
Alex: Heads-up — ApolloIA POC kickoff 10am PT tomorrow. They want to run a custom variant and need onboarding checks (performance + security + pricing). Can @Maria or @Joel help triage?
Maria: On it. Can you drop the model name + a short description of the workload? latency SLOs? expected qps?
Alex: Model: apollo-xl-cust-v1 (weird name, I know). It's a 32B transformer, customer says they've quantized to int8 and added a custom top-k sampling head. Workload: chat assistant with ~2k token context. Target p95 latency <350ms, initial qps ~6, ramp to 20 for POC.
Joel: int8 quantization + long context = usual suspects. Which KV cache approach did they use? Full prefix caching or chunked?
Alex: They mentioned "prefix caching" in email but not sure about chunking. I'll forward the spec.
Maria: For 2k context we need to validate KV cache memory on our Dedicated GPU pools. If prefix caching keeps full past convo, memory could blow up. Also need to confirm attention kernels — some custom heads can break fused-kernel paths.
Joel: Right. Two quick checks I can do if they provide a model.tar with config.json + pytorch weights: 1) run our catalog-conformance script to check attention/layout, 2) run a microbench on our dev rig for int8 path. If both pass, we can create a variant in the catalog flagged as "quant-int8-verified".
Joel: Example command I usually ask for:
```bash
python infra/tools/catalog_check.py --model /path/to/model.tar --check-attention --check-kv --output report.json
```
Maria: Also need to verify tokenizer boundaries for 2k context. Some custom tokenizers pad differently, which affects perf and billing.
Alex: They can share a minimally sanitized package (no customer PII) before the call. Is that acceptable for Private/Dedicated onboarding?
Priya: From security POV, sanitized model artifacts are fine for evaluation. We need a data processing attestation. Also ask them to sign the temporary NDA we use for model upload to our Dedicated test pool. I'll paste the checklist.
Priya: Security checklist highlights:
- Model artifact MD5 + origin assertion
- No embedded PII or secret keys in weights/metadata
- Retention period: sandbox artifacts auto-delete after 14 days
- Audit logging enabled on the Dedicated test pool
(we can relax retention during enterprise contracts)
security-bot: Created ticket SEC-3241 for ApolloIA artifact review — https://jira.redwood/SEC-3241
Alex: Perfect, thanks @Priya. Maria/Joel — how long for the conformance + microbench? We need numbers before the 10am kickoff.
Joel: If they drop the tar now I can run the checks in ~90 minutes on dev cluster. Microbench gives p50/p95 on our 1xA100 test instance; extrapolation to Dedicated pool should be fine but I'll include notes about batching and KV strategy.
Maria: I'll run tokenizer + config sanity checks in parallel — 30–45m. I'll also flag any incompatible ops that break our optimized kernels.
Grace: Heads-up on billing: quant-int8 variants sometimes reduce cost ~30–45% but may increase inference tail if kernel fallbacks happen. We should prepare two pricing lines for the POC: (1) standard hosted rate with test discounts, (2) Dedicated trial rate with hourly reserved capacity estimate. Alex, can you share expected POC duration and if they want SLA?
Alex: POC 2 weeks, no SLA initially, but they asked about future Dedicated contract SLA. For POC we aim for minimal friction.
Grace: Ok — I'll draft a short pricing note: estimated cost for 2-week POC with reserved dev pool (1xA100 equivalent) and estimated per-token cost assuming int8 throughput. Will share in thread.
Alex: Thanks. One last ask from their infra: does Redwood support KV cache segment eviction for long-running chats? They want a policy to evict older prefixes beyond 8k tokens automatically.
Joel: We support LRU segment eviction and prefix summary strategies. For >2k context you should switch to chunked KV + rolling summaries. I'll attach a config snippet they can use:
```json
{
  "kv_policy": "rolling_summary",
  "chunk_size": 1024,
  "eviction_threshold_tokens": 8192,
  "summary_interval_msgs": 20
}
```
Maria: FYI: if they insist on keeping full prefix always, cost/backpressure will increase a lot. Recommend rolling_summary for POC.
Priya: Also add the requirement that any user data used in summaries must be pseudonymized before upload during POC.
Alex: Got it. I'll request the model bundle + confirm NDA and retention terms with them now.
jira-bot: Created ticket SALES-1109 ApolloIA POC onboarding — https://jira.redwood/SALES-1109 (assigned to Maria, Joel) :tada:
Alex: Great. I'll post artifacts to the ticket and ping when uploaded. Thanks everyone :rocket:
